spec.description: Database admin-plane integration family. Engine-agnostic — providers (postgres-admin, mysql-admin, mongo-admin, ...) implement the same operations against different DB engines. Most common pattern: workflow chains secrets-management/rotate_secret → database-admin/alter_user_password for end-to-end credential rotation.

operations.name: ensure_user
operations.description: Idempotent CREATE/ALTER USER with password + roles + attributes.

operations.name: alter_user_password
operations.description: Rotate one user's password — typically called right after secrets-management/rotate_secret.

operations.name: drop_user
operations.description: DROP USER, optionally REASSIGN owned objects first.
